items.title: Reduce motion stays where you set it

items.title: Smoother controls during heavy background work

items.title: Stronger crash protection and diagnostics

items.title: Smaller install and faster startup

items.title: Cleaner background WebView2 memory

items.title: Updated capture hook, GameInput, and frame generation

items.title: More reliable crash reports and helper timeouts
items.detail: Fixes crashes from timed-out helper output streams and keeps diagnostic reports readable without over-redacting harmless names.

items.title: Interactive guided tour
items.detail: Walks through every room and shortcut on first open with a live spotlight, skippable anytime and replayable from Settings › About or Ctrl+K.

items.title: Redesigned Library deck, Store & Game Page
items.detail: Clean poster deck with scroll arrows, details directly from the menu, centered Activate key dialog, and smooth layout without load jumps.

items.title: Wooting keyboard tuning & profile backups
items.detail: Switch profiles, adjust actuation and Rapid Trigger, view the live key map, and back up or restore Wooting profiles inside Devices.

items.title: Upgraded controller navigation
items.detail: Spatial focus movement, shoulder room switching, stick scrolling, and live controller prompts across rooms and overlays.

items.title: Automatic Riot hours sync & export import
items.detail: Reads local Riot Client match history automatically, imports Riot privacy exports (.zip/.json), and supports cloud Riot hours sync.

items.title: Cleaner Settings & cross-room polish
items.detail: Reorganized Settings sidebar, sharper Apps and Shaders contrast, aligned Discord sidebar, prompt Exo Mouse fallback, and GPU-only confirm transitions.

items.title: Exo AI real-time core & unified PC tuning
items.detail: Silently keeps safe Best Settings aligned in the background, adds anti-cheat-safe NVML GPU fan curves, upgrades Autopilot to 2s checks with alt-tab 1 ms timer restore, and consolidates This PC into Exo AI, Apps, Storage, and Devices.

items.title: Authentic AMOLED Liquid Glass & clean icons
items.detail: Restores true backdrop-blur Liquid Glass over pure black surfaces without synthetic gradient sheens, restores clean icons while keeping Goeist, and removes the Library scroll scrubber.

items.title: Synced Discord DM pinning
items.detail: Pin 1:1 and group DMs directly from conversation headers or context menus, synced cleanly across your signed-in Exo account.

items.title: Apps & Startup reliability fixes
items.detail: Refreshes Startup state on reopen, supports re-enabling Task Manager-disabled entries inline, groups duplicate startup errors, and filters shell-host memory inflation.

items.title: Reliable elevated Shaders optimization & Latency check
items.detail: Fixes elevated Optimize Cache failures, adds 10-second DPC latency checks under System tuning, and automatically reverts failing MSI device modes.

items.title: Real Liquid Glass & pure black surfaces
items.detail: Top bar Search, Rooms, and Tools wear true backdrop-blur Liquid Glass over pure black rooms with zero-scroll game sheets.

items.title: Zero-scroll game pages
items.detail: Stats, upscalers, shaders, Optimize, HDR, and frame generation sit cleanly inline on every game page with Steam Family badges.

items.title: Redesigned PC › Apps uninstaller
items.detail: Apps rows show Startup, Exo replaces, and Bloat tags inline alongside grouped dependency counts and compact cleanup notices.

items.title: Discord screen share & Stage channels
items.detail: Share screens smoothly with HDR tonemapping, H.265/H.264 fallback, hot-swappable sources, Stage channels, gift embeds, and Soundboard search.

items.title: Automatic Exo EQ & live Audio controls
items.detail: AutoEq curves and per-game sound profiles switch automatically, with reliable Windows Output, Microphone, and Exo Voice controls.

items.title: Always-on Autopilot & quiet idle
items.detail: Autopilot runs continuously without extra switches, Memory Integrity checks BIOS virtualization, and idle WebView animations pause at rest.

items.title: Exo Shaders 1.4.8 & in-repo Capture
items.detail: Bundles SCSKiller 1.4.8 shader improvements alongside Native AOT Exo Capture and polished Liquid Glass FPS overlay readouts.

items.title: Safer WuWa, Steam overlay & Store opens
items.detail: Wuthering Waves anti-cheat protection, opt-in Steam overlay defaults, reliable Riot/Store launches, and automatic compression budgets.

items.title: Music player layout polish
items.detail: Refined Music controls and half-screen player sizing so transport and Favorites controls always sit cleanly side by side.

items.title: Start with Windows & quiet tray launch
items.detail: Set Start with Windows during setup and launch straight to the tray with --startup when signing into Windows.

items.title: Autopilot session reports
items.detail: After you play, PC › Autopilot shows what made a game stutter, from a background app to a full graphics card, and what to do about it.

items.title: Exo EQ for your headphones
items.detail: Pick your headphones and Exo corrects their sound with Bass, Vocal, Footsteps or custom bands, carrying over Lucid's settings. Thank you, tekkusai, for Lucid.

items.title: A cleaner Library with search and filters
items.detail: Games sit edge to edge with an A-Z scrubber, natural search, combinable filter chips, Steam Family sharing badges, and unreleased or beta details.

items.title: Game pages, details on demand
items.detail: A game opens on its cover, name and Play; Info (or I) opens upscalers, shaders, frame generation, HDR and Optimize beside it on every game.

items.title: Only what works on your PC
items.detail: Settings your PC, screen or controller can't use stay hidden, single choices apply automatically, and PC shows only actionable updates.

items.title: Riot hours and tracker.gg status
items.detail: VALORANT and League show hours played like Steam games; if tracker.gg won't import past hours, Exo says so and keeps counting sessions.

items.title: Captures, like Photos
items.detail: Clips and screenshots sit in one daily grid with a month scrubber, filter chips, name blur, text copy, and Discord sharing with automatic trim.

items.title: Network group and encrypted Cloudflare DNS
items.detail: Best settings › Network sets adapter power saving, TCP defaults and encrypted Cloudflare DNS in one prompt with a speed check and full Undo.

items.title: Games with anti-cheat and NBA 2K26
items.detail: Games with anti-cheat stay untouched (captures record from the screen, Riot untouched); NBA 2K26 offers an offline no-anti-cheat mode.

items.title: Music, full window
items.detail: Press F or the full-window button in Music for the cover large, its colors around it and the lyrics big beside it; Esc goes back.

items.title: Compress games
items.detail: Windows' own compression makes games smaller on disk, and they play as before.

items.title: Liquid Glass, AMOLED black and Goeist
items.detail: Exo uses pure black under frosted Liquid Glass with Goeist rounded type and Lucide icons that clearly show active and filled states.

items.title: Discord, laid out like Discord
items.detail: Servers across the top, Shop beside Home, reliable GIF and Imgur loading, and members and voice controls right beside the conversation.

items.title: Five rooms, centered, and unified downloads
items.detail: Library, Store, Discord, Music and PC sit centered in the top bar, Devices sits in PC, and Library › More › Downloads holds every download.

items.title: Upscalers and drivers stay configured
items.detail: DLSS, FSR and XeSS update while idle, driver installs run cleanly full-screen, and Optimize, driver settings and start-up choices restore after.

items.title: Notices, banner and FPS counter
items.detail: Notices rise at the bottom right, achievement banners show their tier, and the FPS counter sits in its own floating glass pill.

items.title: Exo account and app diagnostics
items.detail: Exo signs you in to keep your library and playtime; Settings › Privacy lets you inspect or delete anonymous app data.

items.title: Frame generation for more cards
items.detail: Best settings reaches GeForce GTX 900+, Radeon RX 400+, Radeon integrated graphics and Intel Arc, and each game says what applied.

items.title: Replay length fits your PC
items.detail: Exo can shorten instant replay without lowering quality, and Capture settings shows how much storage headroom you can save.

items.title: Everything you chose is backed up
items.detail: Folders, added games, peripheral settings, wishlists, Riot ID and music choices back up and sync automatically across your PCs.

items.title: Updates wait safely and keep covers
items.detail: In-game updates download after disk checks and install on exit; library covers stay intact when an offline store fails.

items.title: Per-game Play/Stop and quieter idle
items.detail: Starting one game no longer holds Play and Stop for every other game, and background timers rest while Exo is hidden.

items.title: Crash reports are not lost
items.detail: A report Exo's service can't take right now stays on your PC and sends automatically on a later start.

items.title: A System group in Best settings
items.detail: Exo restores Windows defaults changed by tweak scripts behind a restore point, with Services and Memory Integrity opt-in.

items.title: Sensor angle and 40+ more mice
items.detail: Adjust Razer Viper V3 Pro sensor rotation a degree at a time in Devices, plus support for 40 more SteelSeries mice and wake recovery.

items.title: Cleaner store shelf and library games
items.detail: Removed the unfinished Exo Store preview, prevented unsaveable wishlists, and stopped games like Costume Quest from being hidden.

items.title: One Exo account for every Exo app
items.detail: Sign up or sign in once, right after Welcome. Your settings and playtime sync between your PCs.

items.title: Steam sign-in with no key
items.detail: Scan a QR code in the Steam app, or sign in with your account name, to list every game you own and your Family games.

items.title: Exo wakes less in the background
items.detail: Game detection follows windows instead of polling, and Exo's page sleeps while Exo is hidden.

items.title: Cleaning keeps your sign-ins and saves
items.detail: Junk cleaning never removes sign-in data, credentials, game saves or shader caches, and waits for any program still using a file.

items.title: A calmer Library
items.detail: The accounts banner sits above your games instead of over them, and keyboard focus stays inside Settings and other sheets.

items.title: Help goes to getexo.app/help
items.detail: The help link opens Exo's help page, and a release card posts from Exo's own service.

items.title: Help improve Exo is your choice
items.detail: App data and crash reports stay off until you choose. View what's sent shows them, and Delete my data removes what Exo holds.

items.title: Updates come from Exo only
items.detail: Exo's own updates are fetched from Exo's update address, never from GitHub.

items.title: The PC stays awake while Exo works
items.detail: Downloads, installs and shader warming keep it awake. Settings › General turns that off.

items.title: Uninstall says why an app stays
items.detail: When Windows, a game or Exo needs an app, System › Apps says why beside it.

items.title: A file in use names its program
items.detail: If a game's update or uninstall is blocked, the message names the program holding the file. Exo closes nothing.

items.title: Shader compiles finish
items.detail: Compiles that restarted or timed out now finish, on SCSKiller 1.4.6. Exo Shaders no longer uses SCSKiller's servers or Patreon.

items.title: Crash reports are on by default
items.detail: When Exo hits an error, freezes or a failure happens, one short scrubbed report goes to Exo's service. About says what is sent.

items.title: Discord's room lines up
items.detail: The server and DM lists clear the call panel, the new-messages bar sits above the conversation, and the room fits at 1000 to 1920 px.

items.title: Discord calls, with Discord's controls
items.detail: The call panel is one piece at the bottom left, and the mic and speakers buttons open their device menus.

items.title: Clips play as you open them
items.detail: A clip starts on its own, and the Captures list is leaner. Back or Escape returns to the list.

items.title: HDR for games on the right screen
items.detail: HDR turns on for the screen your game is on, and turns back off a few seconds after the game closes.

items.title: Optional crash reports
items.detail: Settings › General can send one scrubbed report when you copy an error. It's off by default, and Preview shows the exact text first.

items.title: Discord looks like Discord
items.detail: Channels, conversations, people, Friends and the message box follow the official app.

items.title: Tabler icons
items.detail: Every icon is now a light, minimal Tabler icon that fits what it does.

items.title: Discord, laid out like Discord
items.detail: Your servers run down the left, then channels, the conversation and the people, with Friends and Active Now back.

items.title: Changelog
items.detail: Settings has every release's notes now, all the way back.

items.title: Start maximized
items.detail: Turn it on in Settings and Exo always opens maximized.

items.title: Spotify loads, or says why
items.detail: A slow Spotify start reloads itself instead of loading forever.

items.title: Spotify always loads
items.detail: Exo closes the Spotify app when it starts its own player, so the player no longer fails to load.

items.title: Lucid comes with Exo
items.detail: Your headphone EQ is inside Exo now, with no window or tray icon; your audio's page is how you run it.

items.title: Make reel
items.detail: Join a game's clips into one video, copied without re-encoding when they match.

items.title: Play, with friends
items.detail: Turn on Show Play in Settings to see who is on each game and launch one together.

items.title: Uninstall clears up after itself
items.detail: Pressing Uninstall also removes what the program left behind, and Put back returns it.

items.title: Auto tune and more Optimize
items.detail: One press finds a lower voltage or a faster clock for your graphics card, and Optimize covers 12 more games.

items.title: More tests for your mouse and controller
items.detail: Check a wireless mouse for dropouts, see your USB devices, and test a controller's triggers and buttons.

items.title: New icons, and the facts are back
items.detail: Every icon is redrawn as one set, and each room shows its numbers again with room to breathe.

items.title: Discord is now Home
items.detail: It opens on what your friends are playing, and servers and messages have new places along the top.

items.title: Share my games
items.detail: Turn it on and friends see the game you opened from Exo. It stays off until you do.

items.title: Exo says less
items.detail: Every room lost its extra words and buttons, so what you came for is all that's on screen.

items.title: An FPS counter
items.detail: Turn it on in Settings for games that don't have their own: one small line in a top corner.

items.title: Music picks up where it was
items.detail: Coming back after Music has been idle just works, and the volume slider no longer hangs.

items.title: Your headphones stay picked

items.title: Noise suppression built in
items.detail: Exo's AI noise suppression comes with the app, so your mic is clean from the first call.

items.title: Streams keep playing

items.title: No false voice warnings
items.detail: The noise suppression notice and the silent-mic warning only show when something is really wrong.

items.title: Settings has its sidebar again
items.detail: Each room's settings come first, Discord's included, then Exo's own.

items.title: Exo sleeps while you play
items.detail: Hidden while a game runs, Exo suspends its page entirely and wakes exactly where you left it.

items.title: Covers at their shown size
items.detail: Every cover arrives scaled to its card, so cover-heavy pages open faster and use less memory.

items.title: Motion matched to your PC
items.detail: Exo reads your graphics and screen and sets its own motion and material, with nothing to set.

items.title: New versions show up within a minute
items.detail: The update address turns its answer over every minute instead of five.

items.title: Go Live at full quality
items.detail: Your stream climbs back to full quality even when your connection always drops a little.

items.title: Stream controls by Disconnect
items.detail: Change what you share or stop streaming right from the voice bar.

items.title: Steam overlay and DLC switches
items.detail: Turn a game's Steam overlay off for good, and switch any DLC you own.

items.title: Out of your way in games
items.detail: Exo never takes the focus as it starts during a game, and its disk work yields to the game's.

items.title: Quiet mics stop cutting out
items.detail: A microphone that can't be turned up is lifted by Exo before noise suppression decides.

items.title: Startup cleaned up
items.detail: One Clean up turns off the startup apps and hidden tasks you don't need.

items.title: The PC room on one page
items.detail: Drives, updates, apps and your card's own control panel, all in one place.

items.title: No ads in your music again
items.detail: Exo Shield blocks ads in the music players again on a new install or an update.

items.title: DLSS frame generation on RTX 20 and 30
items.detail: Games with DLSS Frame Generation can turn it on with an older RTX card, kept on the newest version for you.

items.title: Optimize Rocket League and Phantom Blade Zero
items.detail: The best settings for your PC, set again by themselves after a game update.

items.title: Calls stay out of streams and clips
items.detail: Go Live and your clips leave the call's voices out, so nobody hears themselves echo.

items.title: Your drives in the PC room
items.detail: Each SSD and hard drive with its temperature, health and speed, and their fixes in Best settings.

items.title: Update before you start
items.detail: When a new Exo is out, it asks once as it opens, never in the middle of a game.

items.title: Your voice stays clean in games
items.detail: Exo Voice keeps your room out while a game runs, and is ready the moment you join a call.

items.title: Only My Voice knows you

items.title: Cleaner calls
items.detail: One green ring around whoever is talking, and names over pictures without a second edge.

items.title: Report and every right-click menu
items.detail: Report a message, a person, a server or an event with Discord's own questions, and right-click a server, thread or post for its full menu.

items.title: Listen along
items.detail: Play what a Discord friend is listening to, in time, on your own Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube Music.

items.title: Steady 60 fps clips
items.detail: Clips and recordings keep an even 60 fps, so a replay no longer drops frames.

items.title: Notes in Captures
items.detail: Notes that save as you type, any text file opened in tabs that come back after a restart, and find, spelling and Markdown.

items.title: New drivers found for you

items.title: Optimize Modern Warfare 4
items.detail: One press sets MW4's own settings for your PC, where guides, benchmarks and shared configs agree.

items.title: Fits every screen

items.title: Your controller's light and sound

items.title: A picture for every device

items.title: Judge a game before you buy

items.title: Your controller's own page

items.title: Calibrate your sticks
items.detail: Your DualSense recenters and maps its sticks with its own routine, and Undo puts it back.

items.title: Edge profiles in Exo
items.detail: Edit your DualSense Edge's four profiles, stick curves, triggers and back buttons, stored in the controller.

items.title: Games read your controller

items.title: The right USB port

items.title: Steadier shader compiles
items.detail: Exo Shaders takes SCSKiller 1.3.3's fixes: no compile stuck at 100%, and stopped ones pick up where they were.

items.title: Devices, each as itself
items.detail: Your mouse, keyboard, headphones and controller as cards with their real pictures; press one to open its page.

items.title: A page for your headphones
items.detail: Pick the pair you wear and set up Lucid, Game Mode and Night Shift on one screen.

items.title: PC, with game runtimes
items.detail: System is now PC, and its Apps page installs or repairs every runtime games need in one press.

items.title: Exo's own uninstaller
items.detail: PC › Apps uninstalls any app with a deep clean of what it leaves behind, shown before anything goes.

items.title: Music opens in one piece
items.detail: No more squares and jumps when Music first opens: it fades in whole.

items.title: Sharper Liquid Glass
items.detail: Cleaner glass edges, no scrollbars, and lists that fade into their panel instead of being cut off.

items.title: No clicks from Only my voice
items.detail: When it holds back a voice, it fades it out instead of cutting it off, so nobody in the call hears a click.

items.title: Hums stay out of the call
items.detail: A steady buzz near your mic no longer keeps it open, and Only my voice no longer switches itself off because of noise.

items.title: The voice meter works again

items.title: Your mic keeps going
items.detail: Only my voice can no longer mute you for a whole call: if it holds back most of your own speech, it stops and tells you.

items.title: Only my voice keeps learning
items.detail: After you teach it once, it learns from calls where it’s clearly you, and Settings shows how much it has learned.

items.title: Purges clear at once
items.detail: Messages a moderator’s bot purges disappear right away, and mentions name the person instead of @unknown-user.

items.title: New forum posts appear live

items.title: Razer receivers connect
items.detail: Exo Mouse finds the right interface on a Razer receiver by itself.

items.title: A lighter Refresh
items.detail: Library’s Refresh skips the games you hid.

items.title: Exo Voice is Exo's own
items.detail: Noise suppression runs Exo's own AI end to end — Krisp is gone — and Hear your voice plays live exactly what the call sends.

items.title: A Store made for you
items.detail: Discover leads with games picked from what you play and wish for, marks why on each cover, and leaves out games you already own.

items.title: A release calendar
items.detail: The Store's Calendar shows what just came out and what's coming, your wishlist first.

items.title: Look into a voice channel

items.title: Stream volume
items.detail: While you watch someone's Go Live, their menu has Stream volume and Mute stream, as in Discord.

items.title: More from your friends

items.title: Pictures send smaller

items.title: Bigger reactions

items.title: Recordings take less room
items.detail: While you aren't playing, Exo quietly re-saves your recordings at about a third of the size.

items.title: Portrait screens

items.title: Games on the fast chip

items.title: Best settings in one press
items.detail: System › This PC sets your power plan, driver profile and HDR together.

items.title: HDR before the game starts
items.detail: Games that check for HDR only at launch now find it on.

items.title: Riot hours fix themselves
items.detail: VALORANT and League hours that were counted too high correct themselves on the next refresh.

items.title: GOG pauses keep their progress
items.detail: Pausing a GOG download no longer throws away what it already has.

items.title: More mice
items.detail: Exo Mouse now works with Scyrox and Hitscan mice, with updated Lamzu and Pulsar support.

items.title: Run your server from Exo
items.detail: Server Settings has every page Discord's does, from Access and Onboarding to invites, roles and the Server Guide.

items.title: Group DMs and video calls

items.title: Bookmarks and reminders

items.title: Message requests
items.detail: DMs from people you don't know wait apart from your chats until you accept them.

items.title: Previews that play
items.detail: YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo, TikTok and SoundCloud links play right in the chat.

items.title: React in one press
items.detail: Your favorite reactions sit on every message, and a custom status shows what you're up to.

items.title: Honest compile times
items.detail: Shaders learns how long each game takes on your PC, and tells ready games apart.

items.title: Snips at once
items.detail: Snip opens instantly and stays light, even across several screens.

items.title: Thanks to snekxs

items.title: Starts lighter
items.detail: Exo opens sooner and uses about a third less memory: a room you don't open doesn't load.

items.title: Select several games

items.title: Arrange your folders
items.detail: Drag a folder to move it, or use Move earlier and Move later on its menu.

items.title: Watch several streams
items.detail: Watch more than one friend's Go Live at a time, each with its own sound.

items.title: Streams that look and sound right
items.detail: Friends' streams show whole and stay sharp, and your stream carries your games and music, never your own voice.

items.title: Glass that stays glass

items.title: The newest Exo Shaders

items.title: Clearer voice
items.detail: Fans, desk knocks and keyboard clicks are taken out of your mic, and your words aren't cut off.

items.title: Discord stays fast
items.detail: Messages and profiles load instantly, even right after you switch windows.

items.title: Go Live your friends can watch
items.detail: Your stream plays smoothly on Discord's app, in sharper H.265 when everyone watching can play it.

items.title: Watch friends' streams
items.detail: Open a friend's Go Live and watch it right in Exo.

items.title: Lighter on your PC
items.detail: Calls with clips on and the streams you watch take far less of your processor and graphics card.

items.title: Discord, done right
items.detail: Every channel opens, chats open at the newest message, and links show as previews.

items.title: Gifts in your Library
items.detail: Games friends give you on Steam or Epic show in your Library, ready to accept in one click. Sign in to Steam once in Settings › Game stores.

items.title: Folders you can peek into
items.detail: Hover a folder and its games rise out of it.

items.title: Folders your way
items.detail: Sort each folder its own way, put a game in more than one folder, and give a folder a picture of your own.

items.title: Hide games
items.detail: Right-click a game and choose Hide to keep it out of your Library. Hidden games in the sort menu shows them again.

items.title: Sharper covers
items.detail: Game covers in your Library look as crisp as on the game's own page.

items.title: Fewer shader stutters
items.detail: Compiled shaders are kept on NVIDIA's newest drivers instead of being thrown away.

items.title: More mice
items.detail: Exo Mouse supports 40 more SteelSeries mice and keeps working after your PC sleeps.
